text: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.'"
"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get what they intended.'"
"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'None of you truly believes until he wishes for his brother what he wishes for himself.'"
